title: GradBias: Unveiling Word Influence on Bias in Text-to-Image Generative Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and quantifying demographic and object-level biases in generative models. While it mentions 'ethical issues' as a motivation, the actual study and evaluation are centered on social and perceptual biases (e.g., gender, race, age, and object types) rather than religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical systems.
